class.name: ResonanceRuntimeConfig
class.brief_description: Steam Audio runtime settings for ResonanceRuntime. Structure aligned with Steam Audio Settings.
class.description: Assign on [ResonanceRuntime]. Groups follow Steam Audio Settings (HRTF, ray tracer, occlusion, reflections, pathing, scheduling). Sample rate and frame size follow the Godot mixer, not this resource. Emits signals when reflection type, pathing, bake order, or reinit/live/routing properties change. Bus routing uses [member bus] and [member reverb_bus_name].

signal.name: native_engine_reinit_requested
signal.description: Emitted when a property requires [method ResonanceServer.reinit_audio_engine].

signal.name: runtime_live_config_changed
signal.description: Emitted when a live-patchable property changes (no full engine reinit).

signal.name: runtime_routing_changed
signal.description: Emitted when bus routing fields change ([member bus] / [member reverb_bus_name]).

method.name: get_effective_realtime_rays
method.description: Returns [param realtime_rays] unchanged. [param os_name] reserved for future per-OS caps; pass [method OS.get_name].

method.name: get_bus_effective
method.description: Effective Direct + Pathing bus. Empty = Master.

method.name: get_reverb_bus_name_effective
method.description: Effective reverb bus name. Empty = ResonanceReverb.

method.name: get_hrtf_sofa_effective
method.description: Active custom SOFA from [member hrtf_sofa_assets] at [member hrtf_sofa_selected_index], or first valid entry. Null = embedded HRTF.

method.name: get_config
method.description: Dictionary for [method ResonanceServer.init_audio_engine] (includes AudioServer sample rate). Bus names are handled by [ResonanceRuntime] only.

method.name: create_default
method.description: Default config for editor/fallback when no [ResonanceRuntime] is present.

members.member: Target bus for Direct + Pathing. Empty = Master. Fallback when players use Global bus override.
Bus for [ResonanceAudioEffect] (Convolution/TAN) and the activator. Empty = ResonanceReverb. Send follows [method get_bus_effective].
Use virtual surround instead of HRTF when applicable.
Non-HRTF direct speaker layout channel count (1/2/4/6/8). Invalid values become stereo. Requires engine reinit while running.
Default HRTF on the dry path when a player uses Use Global. Requires a loaded HRTF.
HRTF when decoding shared Convolution/TAN mixer output on [member reverb_bus_name]. Runtime change needs reinit; brief silence until prewarm.
Default HRTF in the pathing effect when a player uses Use Global.
HRTF gain (dB) for the embedded default HRTF; added to each custom SOFA asset volume.
Embedded HRTF only: [code]0[/code] None, [code]1[/code] RMS. Custom SOFA uses the asset's norm type.
SOFA HRTF resources. Empty = embedded default HRTF.
Index into [member hrtf_sofa_assets] (clamped at runtime).
Use bilinear HRTF interpolation (smoother motion, more CPU).
Third-person perspective correction for spatialized sources. Live-patched; no engine restart.
Perspective factor (0.5-2.0). Live-patched like [member perspective_correction_enabled].
For players with reflections Use Global: [code]0[/code] Baked (probes), [code]1[/code] Realtime (needs [member realtime_rays] > 0).
[code]0[/code] Convolution, [code]1[/code] Parametric, [code]2[/code] Hybrid, [code]3[/code] TrueAudio Next (AMD GPU; else falls back).
Realtime HOA order (1-3) for simulator, mixer, and decode. Changing triggers engine reinit. Distinct from [member bake_ambisonic_order].
Legacy alias for [member realtime_ambisonic_order] (config dict key [code]ambisonic_order[/code]).
Global bake HOA order for probe IRs. Per-volume override on [url=#ResonanceBakeConfig]ResonanceBakeConfig[/url]. Does not reinit the engine.
Realtime reflection rays. [code]0[/code] = Off. Higher = more quality and CPU; uses [member scene_type].
Realtime reflection bounces (1-64).
Min irradiance sampling distance (m). Only when realtime rays > 0.
Diffuse samples per reflection point (8-64).
IR duration (s) for simulation, effect allocation, and EOS tail drain (0.1-10).
Hybrid: convolution IR length (s) before parametric tail. Only when Hybrid.
Hybrid crossfade overlap (0-100) between convolution and parametric.
Enable pathing. Needs baked pathing layers. Live-togglable when the simulator was created with pathing; first enable after pathing-off may reinit.
Normalize pathing EQ (less bright). Live-patchable.
Visibility samples for bake and runtime (1-16). Changing at runtime reinits the engine.
Baking/runtime visibility range (m). Live-patchable.
Bake-only max path length between probes (m).
Probe visibility sphere radius (m). Live-patchable.
Fraction of unoccluded rays to link probes (0-1). Live-patchable.
Default path validation when a player uses Use Global. Live-patchable.
Default alternate-path search when a player uses Use Global. Needs validation on; CPU-heavy. Live-patchable.
[code]0[/code] Raycast, [code]1[/code] Volumetric ([member max_occlusion_samples]).
Simulator cap for volumetric occlusion samples. Per-source samples are clamped to this.
Direct transmission: [code]0[/code] frequency-independent, [code]1[/code] 3-band. Path depth uses [member max_transmission_surfaces].
Default [code]numTransmissionRays[/code] (1-256). [code]1[/code] = nearest surface only. Used when players Use Global.
Preset for sim intervals: [code]0[/code] Custom, [code]1[/code] Quality, [code]2[/code] Balanced, [code]3[/code] Performance. Manual knob edits switch back to Custom.
Fraction of CPU cores for Steam Audio simulation threads (0-1).
Min seconds between RunDirect on wakes without heavy reflections/pathing. [code]0[/code] = every eligible wake.
Min seconds between scheduling RunReflections. [code]0[/code] = every worker tick.
Min seconds between scheduling RunPathing. Same semantics as [member reflections_sim_interval].
Max simultaneous sources for realtime reflections / TAN ([code]maxNumSources[/code]).
Min seconds between applying queued dynamic mesh transforms. [code]0[/code] = every sim tick with updates.
Batch deferred source updates instead of blocking the main thread on a busy simulation mutex.
[code]0[/code] Default, [code]1[/code] Embree, [code]2[/code] Radeon Rays, [code]3[/code] Custom (Godot physics; main-thread sim, no mesh upload).
Custom-scene ray collision mask. [code]-1[/code] = all layers.
Custom-scene [code]rayBatchSize[/code] (1-256). Ignored for Default/Embree/Radeon (batch 1).
OpenCL device for Radeon Rays / TAN: [code]0[/code] GPU, [code]1[/code] CPU, [code]2[/code] Any.
OpenCL device index (0 = first matching).
If last reflections tick exceeds this (us), increase effective reflection interval. [code]0[/code] = off.
Lower bound for adaptive realtime rays when the budget is enabled.
Fraction of max rays recovered per under-budget reflections tick.
Cap on per-tick ray recovery. [code]0[/code] = unlimited.
Seconds added to the effective reflection interval when over budget.
Upper bound (s) for adaptive extra reflection delay.
Per-second reduction of adaptive extra delay when under budget.
If scene commit took at least this many us, skip reflections this wake. [code]0[/code] = off.
Clamp applied IR length (samples). [code]0[/code] = no cap.
Max distance (m) for realtime reflections. [code]0[/code] disables the cull. Farther sources omit reflection flags.
